verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools is a category error for this kind of product. Its only AI tool in evidence, ChatGD, is an internal attorney chat app on Azure OpenAI with RAG, and nothing shows it acting as an MCP client or being offered to users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
